inputs.coordinates: WPILib field coordinates in meters, blue-alliance origin, the same frame the policy was trained in. All velocities and directions are field-relative.

node_vectors.formula: v = (node - robot) / scale_m; if |v| > max_length: v = v / |v| * max_length (scale the whole vector, do not clamp each axis). Node 0 is the node being driven to, node 1 the one after it; at the last node, node 1 = node 0.

rays.formula: ray k points at first_angle_deg + k * step_deg, field-relative, counter-clockwise from +x. d = distance from the robot center along the ray to the nearest edge of any obstacle polygon or of the field walls (range_m + subtract_m if none is hit). value = clamp(d - subtract_m, 0, range_m) / range_m. 0 = bumper touching, 1 = clear.

field.note: Obstacles the policy was trained around (2026 field, lib/field_constants.py IMPASSABLE_RECTS). Rays must be cast against exactly these shapes.

outputs.formula: action = network(inputs), each in -1..1. Field-relative velocity command: vx_mps = action[0] * scale_mps, vy_mps = action[1] * scale_mps. action[2] (omega) was ignored in training (translation only): do not use it.

network.description: Fully connected. For each layer: y = activation(weights * x + biases), weights[out][in]. Output = tanh of the last layer (deterministic SAC action).

tests.description: 200 situations recorded from the Python env (5 full-difficulty routes, deterministic policy). Input test: build the inputs from robot + node + next_node and compare with 'inputs'. Network test: run the network on 'inputs' and compare with 'action'.
